name: Fresha
description: Fresha marketplace discovery without an account: find salons, spas and other venues near a geocode by treatment, filter by a date and time window to see available start times per service, read a venue's public service menu (advertised prices, durations, variants), team, hours and latest reviews, and find professionals and their profiles. Anonymous persisted GraphQL queries on www.fresha.com; reading only, no bookings, holds or carts.

tools.name: Search venues
tools.description: Discovery: find venues offering a treatment near a place, or check which venues have openings on a date; then pass a venue slug to venue_detail.

options.name: availability_date
options.about: Venue-local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Adds each matching service's available start times for that day and keeps only venues with availability. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: availability_start_time_from
options.about: Earliest start time HH:MM (24h, venue-local). Needs availability_date. Pattern: ^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: availability_start_time_to
options.about: Latest start time HH:MM (24h, venue-local). Needs availability_date. Pattern: ^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: has_deals
options.about: Only venues with deals. Default false.

options.name: latitude
options.about: Search centre latitude (WGS84). Always required: without it the site geolocates the proxy exit.

options.name: query
options.about: Free text: a treatment (`massage`), business type or venue name. Pass this and/or treatment_id.

response.about: Search Fresha venues around a latitude/longitude by free text and/or a taxonomy treatment_id, one page of up to 20 venues with their matching services and advertised prices. With availability_date (and an optional HH:MM window) the site returns only venues with openings that day and lists each matching service's available start times, without starting a booking. Persisted query Search_Venues_Query (spec ep-3).
